title: Inventory blood-supply, facility-readiness, and obstetric access sources for LMICs
outcome: A dated source inventory that separates national blood-system indicators, facility readiness measures, stock interruptions, referral or transport data, and obstetric haemorrhage outcomes by what each source can actually measure.
inputs: WHO Global Database on Blood Safety and 2026 blood-safety summary
WHO postpartum haemorrhage roadmap and guidance
National blood-service and maternal-health data documentation where publicly accessible
expected_artifact: datasets.md update plus evidence.json records for each accepted source.
validation_method: Reviewer checks every source for stable URL, source date, access date, geographic and facility grain, indicator definition, data currency, access status, and limitations; at least one source must cover an observed facility-level interruption or readiness item.
done_condition: At least six candidate sources are classified as usable, limited, or rejected, with explicit reasons distinguishing national supply from facility-level availability, interruption, compatibility, referral delay, and obstetric outcome measurement.

title: Crosswalk facility blood availability indicators to obstetric emergency decisions
outcome: A machine-readable indicator crosswalk that preserves each measure's facility grain, observation window, numerator, denominator, missingness, and non-equivalence to time-to-transfusion.
inputs: WHO SARA and HHFA blood-transfusion indicators
facility-level maternal-health and blood-service data dictionaries
expected_artifact: validation.md update and a reviewed indicator crosswalk in datasets.md.
validation_method: Replicator samples each indicator and confirms that its source definition, denominator, observation window, and aggregation rule are preserved without substituting readiness for clinical outcome.
done_condition: Every included indicator has a documented numerator, denominator, facility or national grain, observation window, missingness rule, and explicit statement of whether it can or cannot measure emergency time-to-transfusion.

title: Red-team facility blood-availability evidence for unsafe allocation interpretations
outcome: A failure-mode review covering how incomplete blood data could cause unsafe facility rankings, donor diversion, delayed referral, or false reassurance about transfusion readiness.
validation_method: A red-team reviewer enumerates misuse pathways and tests each against the proposed artifact; a second reviewer confirms that every high-risk pathway is blocked, bounded, or supported by replicated evidence.
done_condition: Every proposed allocation or facility-comparison output has an explicit non-use case, data-quality gate, and red-team disposition before publication.

title: Check whether blood-availability measures change a real health-system decision
outcome: A field-facing review naming the user, decision, timing, and operational constraint for a facility-level blood-availability artifact.
inputs: local blood-service and maternity referral workflow documentation
expected_artifact: playbooks.md update with use and non-use guidance.
validation_method: Field reviewer identifies the actual decision and timing, checks whether the proposed data arrive early enough to matter, and requires a second reviewer to reproduce the non-use-case check.
done_condition: The artifact has a named user, named decision, decision time window, minimum evidence needed, explicit non-use cases, and replicated field-reality review.
